name: VRchaeology
shortDescription: An immersive virtual field school for learning archaeological field methods through excavation, mapping, documentation, and analysis.

heroMedia.alt: VRchaeology cover art: an illuminated cave waterfall and bridge, with the VRchaeology title and Game Studies and Design, The stu/dio mark.

body:
## Learning through fieldwork

Students learn archaeological field methods in an immersive virtual cave: setting up grids, locating and excavating artifacts, mapping features, photographing finds, and running lab analyses. Built in Unreal Engine, VRchaeology connects classroom learning with field practice.

Development continues at the Game Studies and Design (GSD) Stu/dio, with new labs and improvements to the experience. GSD 282: VRchaeology, Spring 2027, was co-created by Laura Shackelford and Sepehr Vaez Afshar. The project is supported by NSF awards 1736235 and 2021460, and Epic MegaGrants.
